notes.title: Landoria Game Development Update #3
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers of Landoria!

We are excited to unveil our latest development video, Update #3, showcasing the incredible progress we've made in crafting an immersive and engaging experience for all players. Here's what you can look forward to:

🌍 Major World Visual and Functional Update
Our revamped world brings a fresh, dynamic feel to Landoria! This update introduces improved mechanics centered around territory interactions, delivering a strategic layer to your adventures.

🗺️ New Terrains for Battle Variety
Prepare to face challenges across diverse landscapes! The addition of new terrains enriches your battles, ensuring every encounter feels unique and rewarding.

🏰 Castle Fortification and Territory Expansion
Your heroes now have the power to fortify castles, turning them into central hubs for territory control. Claim tiles around your castles to expand your domain and unlock bonus stats. Strategic planning will be key to success!

🎭 Streamlined Gameplay—Council Scene Removed
We've simplified gameplay by removing the council scene. All actions are now seamlessly integrated into the world scene for a more cohesive experience.

🕵️ Enhanced Quest Framework
We've refined the quest framework to focus on story progression. With its new maturity, quests will unfold in exciting and meaningful ways, drawing you deeper into the lore of Landoria.

📹 Watch Video Update #3 on Steam now and witness the evolution of Landoria firsthand! Your support continue to inspire us as we push forward in bringing this world to life.

Thank you for being part of our journey!

notes.title: Managing the Economy
notes.notes:
We just dropped a gameplay video update recently to showcase the new trade and fortify mechanic. Trading allows the faction to gain various amounts of gold or items, where as fortify will upgrade the castle to allow more recruiting troop capacity.

In typical 4X fashion, you can manage the faction's economy from the world map. Resources will spawn at the villages and if there is an accessible route, you can send a trade convoy to fetch the resource. Likewise, the opposing forces can also head out to the same location, and see who gets it first. The gold accumulated can be used to fortify castles at the frontlines to help in recovering your armies faster.

What do you think?

notes.title: Current State of the Game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, welcome to Landoria!

[h1]Alpha Gameplay[/h1]
Recently we launched our very first alpha footage of Landoria's gameplay video on April 11, 2024. The main game loop is already complete: you play as a single player against the computer, starting the campaign in the world stage, your heroes enter a lobby scene during an encounter, and the battle scene is where you unleash you skills against the enenmies. The general theme in Landoria is casual cartoon fantasy style with a low-poly 3D visuals.

There are over 130 heroes across 7 factions (including neutral). Each hero has their own set of name, portrait, hero stats, strategy and skills, which we have showcased several in our gameplay video, including lightning strike, metoer storm, sonic boom etc.

[h1]Planned Development[/h1]
There's still a lot more content we need to add to the game:

[list]
[*] Heroes, Skills and Strategies: We are planning about altogether 170 heroes, more skills and strategies to give more variation and uniqueness to the configuration of the individual heroes that you will meet in Landoria. 
[*] Campaign: The game is currently missing a key component, that is the Campaigns. We are only starting to work on Campaigns which will tell the story of Landoria through the encounter and interaction between heroes. Each faction should get at least one campaign, although it may not be released all at once. A lot of artwork is going to be required for this as well. 
[*] Terrain Effect: The terrain upon which the battle happens should affect the strength of the army.  
[*] Visuals and Animations: There are still room for improvement for many of the visual aspects such as the UI elements, battlefield scene design, skills, troop and hero animations. We hope to update them along the way.
[/list]

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
I am currently working full time on Landoria as a solo game dev, and I am excited to work on everything that makes it an enjoyable game. We do not have a fixed release date at the moment, but the next milestone will be a decent playable demo in a couple of months.

[h1]Let's Stay In Touch[/h1]
I hope to connect with you through the Landoria Steam store community hub and YouTube Channel, and to keep you updated in this development journey.

If you like what you see, please wishlist on Steam and subscribe to my YouTube channel. Your support will help to make this project a success. Thank you!

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@codeyplay
